# GameThread

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Threading` · class

```csharp
public static class GameThread
```

Reaches the game thread from another thread: most of the framework must be used from it.

## Properties

### IsCurrent

```csharp
public static bool IsCurrent { get; }
```

Whether the calling thread is the game thread.

### Post

```csharp
public static void Post(Action action)
```

Queues work for the game thread and returns. An exception it throws ends the game, as one in a frame does.

### VerifyCurrent

```csharp
public static void VerifyCurrent(uint tag)
```

Ends the game if the calling thread isn't the game thread, or if it has lost the game thread's synchronization context, so that an await there wouldn't come back to it. This runs in every build, and in a Debug build stops in an attached debugger first.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `tag` | Identifies this check in the report. |
